target.description: Second law of PROTOCOL 13.4 (docs/wsp/research/phys_slice2.md): the eight features of slice; the log's lifted label is scored as p_lift_noted * (p_past_lift - p_past_blow) / (1 - p_past_blow), a scoring-time rule. (no target is a shared quantity); targets: blow_off, past_lift, past_blow, lift_noted, flame_length
excludes: phase_end_time is named here only because ModelSpec.target requires one shared quantity: every target of this model is lane-local and no artifact carries phase_end_time
slice2:blow_off (binary): lane-local target, not a shared quantity
slice2:past_lift (binary): lane-local target, not a shared quantity
slice2:past_blow (binary): lane-local target, not a shared quantity
slice2:lift_noted (binary): lane-local target, not a shared quantity
slice2:flame_length (positive, m): lane-local target, not a shared quantity

features.name: u_coflow
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.u_coflow.centre) / x.u_coflow.scale; refused unless x.u_coflow.lo <= x <= x.u_coflow.hi @1

features.name: u_jet
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.u_jet.centre) / x.u_jet.scale; refused unless x.u_jet.lo <= x <= x.u_jet.hi @1

features.name: burner_id
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.burner_id.centre) / x.burner_id.scale; refused unless x.burner_id.lo <= x <= x.burner_id.hi @1

features.name: x_fuel
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.x_fuel.centre) / x.x_fuel.scale; refused unless x.x_fuel.lo <= x <= x.x_fuel.hi @1

features.name: x_o2
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.x_o2.centre) / x.x_o2.scale; refused unless x.x_o2.lo <= x <= x.x_o2.hi @1

features.name: is_ethane
features.transform: identity: (x - x.is_ethane.centre) / x.is_ethane.scale; refused unless x.is_ethane.lo <= x <= x.is_ethane.hi @1

features.name: is_propane
features.transform: identity: (x - x.is_propane.centre) / x.is_propane.scale; refused unless x.is_propane.lo <= x <= x.is_propane.hi @1

features.name: mdot_jet
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.mdot_jet.centre) / x.mdot_jet.scale; refused unless x.mdot_jet.lo <= x <= x.mdot_jet.hi @1

the log's lifted label is scored as p_lift_noted * (p_past_lift - p_past_blow) / (1 - p_past_blow), a scoring-time rule.","features":[{"name":"u_coflow","unit":"m/s","transform":"ln","description":"duct air velocity (u_coflow_cm_s / 100)"},{"name":"u_jet","unit":"m/s","transform":"ln","description":"mean jet exit velocity (u_jet_m_s)"},{"name":"burner_id","unit":"m","transform":"ln","description":"burner tube inner diameter (burner_id_mm / 1000)"},{"name":"x_fuel","unit":"1","transform":"ln","description":"hydrocarbon mole fraction of the jet gas"},{"name":"x_o2","unit":"1","transform":"ln","description":"cabin oxygen mole fraction (x_o2_cabin)"},{"name":"is_ethane","unit":"1","transform":"identity","description":"1 for ethane"},{"name":"is_propane","unit":"1","transform":"identity","description":"1 for propane (methane is the reference)"},{"name":"mdot_jet","unit":"kg/s","transform":"ln","description":"jet gas mass flow (mdot_jet_mg_s / 1e6); read by flame_length only"}],"targets":[{"name":"blow_off","kind":"binary","unit":null,"shared_quantity":null,"causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"as slice"},{"name":"past_lift","kind":"binary","unit":null,"shared_quantity":null,"causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"the condition is past the lifting limit (the network W0 called lifted)"},{"name":"past_blow","kind":"binary","unit":null,"shared_quantity":null,"causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"the condition is past the blow-off limit, cumulative"},{"name":"lift_noted","kind":"binary","unit":null,"shared_quantity":null,"causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"a lifted flame is written down as lifted; no feature dependence"},{"name":"flame_length","kind":"positive","unit":"m","shared_quantity":null,"causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"as slice (lane-local)"}]}. Each network is N(z) = b0 + skip . z + sum_j w2[j] relu(b1[j] + W1[j, :] . z). A positive target is a mixture of two log-normals of one median exp(N_median), ln-sds N_spread and tail_width * N_spread, weights 1 - tail_weight and tail_weight; a non-positive spread is refused. A binary target is logistic(N_logit). An event target is the competition of log-logistic clocks exp(N_c), shape c.shape, conditioned on no event before the cutoff; the earliest control stage scheduled_stop or flow_stop, and the declared stop condition plus each offset node with a positive weight, take the active mass. Lane-local targets are labelled <slug>:<target> in diagnostics.law and carry no shared quantity. Uncertainty kind: assumed_noise.
